comment: Jubaku inflicts the Slow debuff. If the effect fails to land,
recast will be delayed based on the configured retry duration.
when: hasSpell('Hojo: San', 'Hojo: Ni', 'Hojo: Ichi') and canUseSpell(spell)
(findUsableItem('Toolbag (Kagi)') and freeInventorySlots() > 1 and useItem(me) and wait(1)) or \
(findUsableItem('Toolbag (Cho)') and freeInventorySlots() > 1 and useItem(me) and wait(1))
commands: useSpell(bt) or postpone(vars.ninjutsu.debuffs.hojo.retry or vars.ninjutsu.debuffs.retry or 10)
